products.name: EUROPYA BREAD TOASTER
products.rawDescription: A toaster is a compact kitchen appliance that specializes inÂ making toasted breads, bagels and even some pastries quickly. Toasters have coils facing either side of the item, enabling them to deliver an even level of cooking to both sides. Toasters also feature slide-out crumb trays to make cleaning quick and easy.

products.name: EUROPYA DOUGH SHEETER
products.rawDescription: The dough sheeter can perform a few functions that can be helpful for those who work in the food industry and industrial bakery. It can turn separate batches of dough into a continuous sheet. It can also laminate the layers together without the need for dividers and pocket proofers.

products.name: Europya Icing Machine
products.rawDescription: Europa is primarily made of silicate rock and has a water-ice crust and probably an iron-nickel core. It has a very thin atmosphere, composed primarily of oxygen. Cracks and streaks striate its surface, but craters are relatively few.

products.name: EUROPYA MEAT MINCER
products.rawDescription: A meat grinder (also called a "meat mincer" in the UK) is a kitchen appliance for mincing (fine chopping) and/or mixing of raw or cooked meat, fish, vegetables or similar food. It replaces tools like the mincing knife (which are also used in the preparation of minced meat, filling, etc.)

products.name: EUROPYA MEAT SLICER
products.rawDescription: A meat slicer, also called a slicing machine, deli slicer or simply a slicer, is a tool used in butcher shops and delicatessens to slice meats, sausages, cheeses and other deli products. As compared to a simple knife, using a meat slicer requires less effort, as well as keeps the texture of food more intact.

products.name: EUROPYA VEGETABLE SLICER (IMPORTED)
products.rawDescription: The vegetable slicer machine has wide applications. It can cut potato, cucumber, apple and other vegetables and fruits into the round or diagonal slice. The number, diameter, and angle of the feeding inlet could be customized. There is no restriction on the thickness of the vegetables or fruits.

products.name: Round Waffle Machine
products.rawDescription: Waffle irons made of enameled cast aluminum, can be cleaned with a brush. The waffles measure Ø 190 mm and up to 23 mm thick. The temperature can be set steplessly between 50ËC and 220ËC. The timer can be set up to 15 minutes.

products.name: Single Trolley Rotary Rack Oven
products.rawDescription: Rotary rack oven is essentially a convection oven with removable trolley racks. Air is heated by burning fuel in a chamber. Fuel can be diesel (most popular), LPG, wood, coal and electric. Air is heated by blowing air on chamber, using a centrifugal blower.
